name: Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield Medicare (Elevance Health)
notes: Researched from Anthem's public 'Billing and Payments' member page only (no sign-in, no Quick Pay lookup). The page covers all Anthem members including Medicare: 'Pay via Quick Pay' for a one-time premium payment (opens a member-validation page; its fields are not shown publicly, so lookup fields stay at the family default), 'Go to the member portal' to log in and pay, pay in the Sydney Health app, pay by phone at the Member Services number on the back of the ID card, and mail after opting in to mailed bills in the account (online bills are the default). The FAQ 'How do I add, edit, or delete autopay?' says to do it in the member portal or Sydney Health app. Premiums are a monthly charge; deductibles, copays and coinsurance are paid to providers. No Medicare-specific payment page was found (anthem.com/medicare member pages returned 404), and no fees, methods, grace periods or Social Security deduction details are published there, so those are left out. Sign-in identifier (username) is inferred.

help.title: Ways to pay your premium
paragraphs: Your premium is the monthly charge for your plan. Deductibles, copays and coinsurance are paid directly to your doctors and other providers, not through your premium bill.
Quick Pay: make a fast one-time premium payment. Choose Pay via Quick Pay and confirm your member details.
Log in: pay in the member portal, or log in to the Sydney Health app and pay your bill on the go.
Phone or mail: call the Member Services number on the back of your ID card, or log in to add your mailing address and opt in to receive bills by mail.

help.title: How do I add, edit, or delete autopay?
paragraphs: Log in to the member portal or the Sydney Health app and follow the steps to add, edit or remove autopay.
steps: Log in to the member portal or the Sydney Health app.
Add a payment method, edit the existing one, or remove autopay.

help.title: Getting bills by mail
paragraphs: Bills are delivered online. If you want paper bills, log in, make sure your mailing address is correct and opt in to receive bills by mail.

help.title: Paying in the Sydney Health app
paragraphs: The Sydney Health app lets you log in and pay your premium from your phone, and manage autopay the same way you would in the member portal.

extra.intent: Using Anthem's billing help, find the name of Anthem's mobile app where members can pay their premium and manage autopay. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
Using Anthem's billing help, find out whether copays and deductibles are paid through your Anthem premium bill or somewhere else. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: They are paid directly to your care providers, not through the premium bill.
